findings.reason: The regression now exercises the actual single-artifact observe_skill_content path and current owner resource constants instead of retired markdown_title/discover_skills assumptions. It preserves hidden-control, malformed-UTF8, line, scan, title, and fallback semantics without claiming repository authority from a non-Git temp root.

The broad probe fixture now owns top-level snapshot/report/generated-index contracts only. It uses canonical lowercase 40-hex sourceHead values, tests malformed sourceHead as UNRESOLVED, and no longer patches legacy sha256_file/markdown_title as though they were owner authority paths.
The skill now matches authenticated owner truth: one-artifact title/SHA/Git-blob custody and content-to-HEAD binding are SOURCE_WIRED; the old PROPOSED_NOT_APPLIED owner-binding state is retired.

Compared with prior PR head bf686baacd5d25c5e2445daf40cfe86e61bfe71a, substantive changes are confined to two regression files and one existing skill doctrine; the other two files are governance receipts. No runtime/phone/P0/duplicate architecture was touched.
